# Longjaw

*The thing that grips bargehands: a river croc as long as a barge, deeply touched by the Disturbance, waiting in the deepest pool of the Long Reach. When the water heaves, get clear. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [Longjaw](../monsters/longjaw.md) |
| Arena | [The Heron Pool](../maps/heron_pool.md) |
